notes.title: Small Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Small Update 1.0.1

The Levels Mode has been changed. Now, "random" modes will appear from Level 1 instead of Level 5. The way these "random" modes are chosen has also been updated to add more variety. This update is also included in the demo version.

notes.title: 🎉 Full Game Release! 🎉
notes.notes:
🎉 Full Game Release! 🎉

Dear friends, thank you so much for your support and participation during early access! We are excited to announce the release of version 1.0.0 — the full launch of the game.

What's new in version 1.0.0:
🆕 3 New Game Modes:

 Random Start: The game begins with random symbols of both players already placed on the board. Your strategy starts with a twist!
 Lose is Win: Your goal is to lose the game. Try to hand the victory to your opponent, but be careful!
 Rock Paper Scissors: Before each move, players play a round of "Rock, Paper, Scissors." The winner makes the next move.


🔧 Other improvements and changes:

 Updated Difficulty Settings: Values for easy mode set to 25 and for hard mode set to 98.
 Brief descriptions in modes: Added short descriptions of the game rules for the "Quantum" mode and all mode types in the main menu.
 Improved Cycle Game Mode: Now the symbol that will be removed on the next turn will become semi-transparent instead of flashing.
 Bug fixes and stability improvements: Fixed known issues and improved gameplay stability.


We are incredibly grateful to each of you for your help and support on this journey. There is much more to come, and we hope you enjoy version 1.0.0 and the new modes!

Thank you for your time and feedback — it has made the game better!

See you in the game!
